blocking_findings.summary: AR-T1 was incorrectly classified as identical under typed renaming to the broader generic fibre theorem.
The validator allowed fifteen exact-status, authority, identity, source-contract, freeze, T354, and TAC/SAC mutations.
Seven typed instance or theorem-family source references existed as paths but did not support the named mechanism.
The frozen baseline lacked the audit chain and final source manifest, making result-only mutation tests vacuous.

nonblocking_findings: The eleven countermodels were declared model sketches rather than typed or executable constructions.
The new Lean source was candidate-era rather than already-public custody.
The finite joint-refinement check was a bounded regression, not a general proof.
